spans.s: once n. (often written फेण and prob. connected with √ फण्; but See Uṇ. iii, 3) foam, froth, scum, RV. &c. &c.
moisture of the lips, saliva, Mn. iii, 19
Os Sepiae (white cuttle-fish bone, supposed to be indurated foam of the sea), Car.
N. of a man (son of Uṣad-ratha and father of Su-tapas), Hariv.
